text:
Aisha: Quick handoff for AtlasSync (signed today). Key context: mid-market SaaS, plan to start on hosted API but customer requested EU private eval for data residency. They'll use dense embeddings at scale and have an internal SSO (SAML). Sales flagged EU latency blips in last perf run and procurement asking about 12mo terms 11 six-week cadence for contract negotiation. Renewal risk if onboarding stalls.

Tom: Picking this up as CS lead. Can you attach the final contract and the perf log snippet? Also need the SSO contact for scheduling the SAML handshake.

Aisha: Links posted: https://drive.redwood/AtlasSync/AtlasSync_Final.pdf and https://perf.redwood/atlasync/eu-spikes-2026.log. SSO contact: nina@atlasync.com. Procurement contact: marc@atlasync.com.

Tom: Thanks. Drafting kickoff plan: 1) Confirm internal owners, 2) EU smoke perf test, 3) SAML test window + config, 4) embedding volume forecast + cost controls, 5) Private eval if performance/latency unacceptable. Tentative owners: Tom (CS lead), Ravi (support/runbook & SUP-10221), Zoe (eng/private perf sizing).

Ravi: I'll create the support ticket and start the runbook. Need steps to reproduce the spike and any sample payloads or prompt sets. Also ask if they can whitelist IPs for test.

Zoe: For perf sizing I need: model variant (name + quant), typical max sequence length, expected concurrent requests and tokens/sec, and a representative corpus. Also sharing a sample load command I will run: 

```bash
# example using vegeta for throughput profiling
echo '{"method":"POST","url":"https://api.redwood/v1/generate","body":"{\"model\":\"open-emb-001\",\"input\":\"test prompt\"}","header":{"Authorization":"Bearer $TOKEN","Content-Type":"application/json"}}' > targets.json
vegeta attack -targets=targets.json -rate=50 -duration=30s | vegeta report
```

Zoe: If we see host throttles we can request a temporary dedicated test pool. Will coordinate with eng-infra.

Tom: I'll upload the customer's prompt set and the embed workload CSV to the shared folder. Also, ask AtlasSync to provide three target success metrics (P50/P95 latency, embed cost per 10k vectors, and SAML pass rate).

Aisha: I'll ask Nina to approve a SAML test window for next Tue/Wed morning UTC. Also flagged procurement timeline with SalesOps.

Ravi: Ticket SUP-10221 created and linked to folder. Checklist seeds: reproduce spike, collect request IDs, confirm regional routing, collect sample traces. Added a field for 'workaround/status' for immediate mitigation.

onboard-bot: Enterprise onboarding template attached: https://wiki.redwood/onboarding/enterprise-template. Added a new "EU smoke" test step.

Tom: Owners & next steps summary: - CS lead: Tom (kickoff, weekly updates) - Support: Ravi (SUP-10221 + runbook) - Eng: Zoe (perf testing + private sizing) - Sales: Aisha (SSO approval + procurement timeline)

Tom: Immediate commitments this week: 1) Aisha to get SAML test approval from Nina by EOD Fri. 2) Ravi to populate SUP-10221 with logs and reproducer within 24h. 3) Zoe to review perf logs and confirm additional data needs within 48h. 4) Tom to run cost forecast and propose mitigations in 72h.

Zoe: I'll start with the log extract and reply in-thread with any missing items. Expect first notes in ~36h.

Aisha: Noted, I'll push procurement update to AE and loop Marc.

Tom: Weekly sync cadence proposed: Wednesdays 14:00 UTC. I'll post kickoff notes once SAML window is confirmed. For now marking account as "onboarding-watch" until milestone 1 (SSO validated + first smoke pass).

Ravi: Added comments in SUP-10221 with the perf log link and initial reproducer steps.

Tom: Thanks team. Ping here for blockers and tag @Ravi or @Zoe for urgent support. :thumbsup:
